oneShotSuffix: A short isolated sound effect, dry, no reverb, no background, no music, no voice, no hum, no drone.
loopSuffix: A short seamless ambient loop texture, no music, no voice, no hum, no drone.

cues.role: Matchstick striking at ignition — plays the moment a spark starts burning
prompts: A single wooden match being struck against a rough striker strip, sharp fricative scratch then a tiny hiss, close microphone, short.

cues.role: Razor shears cutting a fuse — the core feedback for every snip
prompts: One sharp snip of steel garden shears cutting a thin string, crisp metallic click, close microphone, very short and percussive.

cues.role: Spark snuffed out in a cut gap — a sad fizzle
prompts: A small spark fizzling out and going dark, wet descending hiss, close microphone, short.

cues.role: Bomb detonation on failure — big but cartoonish
cues.notes: Prompt encodes the 3-layer explosion recipe: sharp crack attack → punchy mid-low body thump → short debris crackle tail, near perspective, tight and dry so it reads on phone speakers and doesn't stall the retry flow.
prompts: A big cartoon bomb detonation: first a very sharp fast crack attack, then a deep punchy boom body that hits low and round, ending with a short crackle of falling debris. Close microphone, tight and dry, compact, medium length, satisfying and chunky. No music, no voice, no reverb, no echoes, no long rumble tail.

A chunky cartoon explosion sound effect: snappy bright crack at the start, then a solid round bass boom with weight, and a quick gravelly debris rattle at the end. Dry close-mic, punchy and full, short tail, no music, no voice, no reverb.

cues.role: Coin ping as each star lights in the win modal — ascending pitch per star
cues.notes: Reuses Wobble Run's coin count sound (samples/coin.wav); game plays it at rate 1.0/1.3/1.6 per star.
prompts: A crisp game-coin collect ping, short and bright.

cues.role: Fuse wick burning bed — plays while any spark is travelling
prompts: A small fuse wick burning and crackling, fast dry sparks popping like static on a thin string, close microphone, seamless loop texture.
